editorial:
Imagine you are on a road trip through Oklahoma and decide to stop in a quiet little town for a break. That is exactly what happens to the couple in this flick, but things go south fast. You quickly realize the town is not as sleepy as it looks. Instead of friendly locals, you find a creepy group of kids who have totally taken over the place. These children worship a scary crow god and they are not afraid to kill anyone who gets in their way. The whole vibe is super unsettling because you never expect kids to be the villains in such a mean way.

What really makes this work is how it builds the tension. The acting is solid for an indie movie, and the shock of seeing young kids act like cold-blooded killers keeps you on edge. It does move a bit slow in the middle, but the payoff is worth it. If you love weird 80s horror, you should definitely grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the gritty details. You could also try renting it on Apple TV if you want a quick scare tonight. It is a wild ride that you won't forget easily.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the couple tries to escape the town, but the children trap them for a big sacrifice. You find out the crow god actually demands blood to keep the town prosperous. Just when it looks like the couple is doomed, a fight breaks out among the kids over who gets to lead the cult. In the chaos, the couple manages to burn down the main shrine and flee the town as it falls into total anarchy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird 80s horror and creepy kids.
